title: Concept: Cloud metadata endpoint referenced in a response
description: A reference to the link-local metadata address 169.254.169.254 in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: The metadata service issues instance credentials to anything that can reach it, and an address printed in a response is a ready-made target for a server-side request forgery.
applicability: One SSRF primitive pointed at this address yields the instance role's temporary credentials.
risk: Link-local metadata is reachable from the instance and worthless to a browser, so its presence means an internal address leaked.
